verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex ships AI features, such as AI-powered compliance support and AI-suggested modifications, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or use external MCP servers. Its REST APIs, webhooks and app integrations are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
